title: Combinations that add up to a target, with reuse
summary: Fill a basket that costs exactly the target, reusing any item as often as you like, trying items in order so no basket is counted twice.
goal: List every basket of items that costs exactly the target

mapping.formal: Each step starts at the current item's index

ladder.name: Try every basket, remove repeats
ladder.idea: Build every sequence of items up to the target, keep those that hit it exactly, and remove baskets that are the same items in a different order.

ladder.name: Add items in order, stop when over
ladder.idea: Sort the items. Add an item and recurse starting from that same item, so baskets are built in non-decreasing order; stop as soon as the next item would overshoot.
ladder.insight: Building each basket in sorted order means every basket is built exactly once, so no de-duplication is needed. Sorting also lets the search stop the moment an item is too expensive.

transfer.problem: Find all ways to make 12 cents from coins of 1, 2 and 5, where order does not matter.
transfer.explanation: It is the same search: add coins in non-decreasing order with reuse, stopping when the total overshoots.

selfCheck: Lets the same item be used again by recursing from the same index.
Never goes back to an earlier item, so no basket repeats.
Stops exploring once the remaining budget is negative or the item is too big.
Records a copy when the remaining budget is exactly zero.
